title: Zenzeta
description: This project gonna give you enhanced vanilla experience and upgrade perfomance of your game!!
body:
# Description
This project will approve your vanila theme feauture , quality of life and perfomance on minecraft vanila by not change way to play game.

 # Modpack Issue
- This project is currently in Beta. You may encounter bugs related to configurations and HUD elements. However, with the correct settings, the pack runs smoothly and without crashes.

- Some settings are optimized for low-end PCs. If your system is more powerful, feel free to adjust them as much as you like (Ex. Voxy mod, Shader quality and etc.).

 # Recommended

- Don't forgot to use resourcepack for full experience :>

# Features

##  Optimization

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

 - Boost your FPS and eliminate lag with optimized entity rendering and smoother chunk updates.

</details>


##  Quality of Life 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

 - Quick Villager Trade

 - See Shulker Box Item
 - Glowing Ore 
 - Vein Mining Ore and Chop Tree in one time _(Shift and Mine to activate)_
 - Show Hunger Grain From Food
 - Carry On _(Left Shrift and Right Click to item or entity to Carry)_
 - Quick Climb (Ex. Ladder , Scaffolding and etc.)
 - Dynamic Light
 - Mouse Tweaks
 - Overlays HUD _(Press H to toggle)_
 - Inventory Sort _(Press R or UI)_
 - Pick Up Notifier
 - Freecam _(Press F4 to toggle)_

</details>

##  More Animation and First Person Animation
 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- First Person Animation
- Item Animation (Ex. New Chest animation , Door animation , Lantern , and etc.)
- UI Animation and Item Animation (When Change Inventory Slot)

</details>


##  Minimap and World Map
 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Minimap
 - World Map _(Press M to open)_

</details>

##  Upgrade Texture

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
 - New Tool Texture

</details>
